# Descriptive Analysis

## Tabular analysis

```{r table1, echo=FALSE}
table_one <- readRDS(
  file = here::here("table/output/table_one.rds")
)

knitr::kable(
  table_one,
  col.names = c("Mental Health Indicator", "Percent"),
  caption = "Mental Health and Substance Use Indicators Among U.S. High School Students, 2023",
  row.names = FALSE,
  align = c("l", "r")
)
```

### Table One Description
Table 1 presents the prevalence of seven mental health, suicide-related, and substance-use indicators among U.S. high school students in 2023. Persistent sadness or hopelessness had the highest reported prevalence at 39.7%, followed by poor mental health at 28.5% and seriously considering suicide at 20.4%. Suicide attempts and illicit drug use had the lowest reported percentages, at 9.5% and 9.9%, respectively.
